name: Ammonides
bio: Ammonides is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors says the poet's date is uncertain.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XI: 201.

poems.title: Book XI, 201
poems.author: Ammonides
poems.text: If anyone had shown Antipatra naked to the Parthians, they would have fled outside the Pillars of Heracles.
